landing.heroTitle: Your edge in prediction markets, automated.
landing.heroSubtitle: Connect Kalshi and Polymarket to Discord, email, and SMS alerts. Build workflows in minutes — no code required.
landing.nodesSectionSubtitle: Connect market data sources to notification actions. More nodes coming soon.
landing.howItWorksSubtitle: No YAML, no JSON, no CLI. Just pick nodes and configure them.
landing.step1Body: Choose Kalshi or Polymarket as your data source. Paste a market ticker or slug, set a price threshold.
landing.step2Body: Chain Discord webhooks, email (AgentMail), and SMS alerts. Use template variables to include live market data.
landing.step3Body: Toggle your workflow live. MarketPing polls the markets and fires alerts the moment your threshold is crossed.
landing.ctaSectionSubtitle: MarketPing Pro — $19/mo. No free tier, no trial.
